verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export or account-exit feature, and no promise of complete export in open formats. The API can retrieve agent run logs and traces, and the CLI can pull agent-created branches to a local machine. These are developer building blocks and partial retrieval paths, not a first-party capability to export all of a user's data and leave, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
